messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: autopage fired for service=metrics-pipeline, alert=prometheus_scrape_drop — 78% of scrape targets in eu-west-1 are failing. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/metrics-scrape-drop :rotating_light:
Julian (oncall): acked — I'm jumping on this. taking ownership for now. any customer-facing impact?
Tara (SRE): I see scrape success rate dropped ~08:22 UTC, spike in 429s from scrape-proxy. logs show repeated `upstream 502` and `429` from exporter-proxy pool.
Alex K: adding context: we rolled exporter-proxy 2 hours ago to pick up TLS cert rotation. could be connection limits.
Priya (platform): tagging network team @morgan — are there any rate-limit changes or WAF rules deployed recently in eu-west-1?
Morgan: not that I'm aware of. I can check firewall logs but nothing scheduled. I'll pull the proxy metrics.
Julian (oncall): runbook step 1: check /dashboards/ingest/scrape-proxy and exporter clusters. I'm looking now.
Tara (SRE): Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/metrics/ingest?scrape_proxy=eu-west-1 — errors spiking, connection queue depth high.
Alex K: quick check: `kubectl get hpa -n monitoring` shows CPU spike on exporter-proxy, target 2 -> current 5 replicas (auto scaled). But pods are crashlooping sometimes. logs: ```
I0210 08:23:11 exporter-proxy main.go:212 connection: dial tcp 10.0.5.12:9100: connect: connection refused
E0210 08:23:12 exporter-proxy main.go:245 upstream error: 502
```
Priya (platform): can we temporarily route scrape traffic to fallback region or increase exporter-proxy concurrency? We have a known fallback policy but needs manual enable.
Julian (oncall): trying a quick mitigation: scaling up exporter-proxy to 10 replicas and bumping env var `MAX_CONNS=2000` to relieve queue. Doing a rolling restart now.
devops-bot: Command accepted: scale deployment exporter-proxy to 10 replicas in monitoring/eu-west-1.
Morgan: I see upstream exporters (node-exporter fleet) responding but a lot of connection resets. Could be SNAT exhaustion on proxy nodes. Checking node ephemeral ports.
Tara (SRE): if SNAT exhaustion, short term fix is to add more proxy nodes or enable connection reuse. Is socket reuse flag enabled?
Alex K: connection reuse is enabled in config but new proxy build changed default timeout. Rolling back to previous image (sha: abc123) might help quickly. Should we rollback?
Julian (oncall): let's do minimal changes first. Priya, approve a rollback if scale doesn't stabilize in 5m.
Priya (platform): approved. If scale doesn't reduce errors in 5m, roll back to abc123.
Julian (oncall): scaling took effect — replicas=10, CPU per pod down a bit. scrape success creeping up from 22% -> 54%.
PagerDuty: Reminder: if incident impact is > 25% customer requests, escalate to P1/RIT. Current impact flagged as potential partial customer degradation.
Tara (SRE): temporary mitigation helped but some pods still show `OOMKilled` in last 10m. Might be memory leak in new build. Logs: ```
panic: runtime: out of memory
goroutine 245 [running]:
main.handleConnection(0xc0001a4000)
```
Alex K: that matches a known regresssion in exporter-proxy v2.1.4. Rolling back now would remove the leak. I'm prepping rollback command.
Julian (oncall): go ahead with rollback. Announce here once complete and update PD status.
devops-bot: Rolling back deployment exporter-proxy to image registry.redwood/exporter-proxy:abc123 — rollout started.
Morgan: while rollback is happening, I'm increasing node SNAT table size and adding two proxy nodes to avoid port exhaustion.
Priya (platform): adding a temporary iptables tuning to extend ephemeral port range: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=\"1024 65535\"` on proxy nodes. Doing via chef.
Tara (SRE): rollback complete — new pods running image abc123, no OOM in startup logs. Scrape success back to ~92% within 2m.
Julian (oncall): confirmed. IncidentBot: please resolve PD alert if service healthy.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: alert resolved for metrics-pipeline (autopage closed) — condition returned to normal.
PagerDuty: Please follow post-incident steps: file incident ticket, link timeline, and schedule root cause analysis.
Alex K: raising incident ticket now: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026 — will include config diff and logs.
Tara (SRE): immediate action items: 1) revert exporter-proxy v2.1.4 from rollout pipeline, 2) add canary ramp for future proxy changes, 3) add SNAT metrics to exporter-proxy dashboard, 4) evaluate memory regression.
Julian (oncall): customer impact: no active customer complaints reported; internal metric showed 5% API error surge for downstream dashboards between 08:22–08:30 UTC. Marking impact as intermittent but contained.
Priya (platform): I'll schedule a follow-up with network team to check SNAT config and add automated guardrails for ephemeral port tuning.
Morgan: I'll correlate kernel conntrack logs and open a trace for the proxy nodes.
Tara (SRE): thanks all. I'll own the postmortem and ping for RCA session tomorrow 10:00 UTC. If anyone has extra logs or heap dumps, upload to the incident ticket.
Julian (oncall): wrapping up handoff to oncall followup. Leaving notes in the ticket. handing to next oncall @Alex K for further RCA. :thumbsup:
Alex K: got it, will drive RCA. Leaving the channel open for 30m for any regression.
Morgan: closing monitoring loop — adding alert rule: scrape_drop > 40% for 5m triggers runbook that checks exporter-proxy image age and SNAT saturation.
Tara (SRE): thanks — nice quick mitigation.
devops-bot: Deployment exporter-proxy scaled back to desired replicas 4 after stability confirmed.
IncidentBot: note: incident closed at 08:36 UTC.
